name: g4_ten_class_foundation_model_screen_v1
purpose: Measure whether a stronger promptable segmentation foundation model improves the frozen best rich-gallery pipeline after the ten-class classifier replacement.
replication_rule: Run seeds 42 and 44 only when a screen arm beats the matched seed-43 SAM-v1 comparator on actual binary-mask Dice.
test_policy: No arm may read test. Select one final configuration from validation, freeze it, then perform at most one final test evaluation.
fixed_modules: ten-class DenseNet121 LayerCAM target logsumexp(nine tumor logits)-normal logit

arms.prompt_contract: same point, box, box+point and dense-grid inputs
same point, box, box+point and dense-grid inputs; official 256-pixel encoder
same operational point, box, box+point and dense-grid inputs; interpretation must disclose that MedSAM was principally trained/evaluated with box prompts

primary_endpoint: mean tumor-image binary-mask Dice on 184 canonical validation tumor images
selection: All candidate choices are frozen before validation polygons are opened.
